title: Cekalla leads Pierz Black to runner-up finish at Pierz Invite - NewsBreak
text:
By Jeffrey Hage ,
7 hours ago
Nathan Cekalla fired a 72 to lead Pierz Black to a second-place team finish at the Pierz Invite.
Cekalla finished third individually, one shot behind co-medalists Josh Hoff of Albany and Evan Swenson of Brainerd, who each carded 71s. Cekalla went out in 37 and came in with a 35.
Brainerd won the team title with a 305. Pierz Black and Albany tied for second with 313s, followed by Milaca at 334, Royalton at 336, Pierz Red at 344, Mora at 352 and Pierz White at 420.
Pierz Black had four golfers finish in the top 17. Ty Leidenfrost tied for seventh with a 78, Beau Virnig tied for 15th with an 81 and Trevor Leblanc placed 17th with an 82. Shay Watercott tied for 19th with an 84, and Brady Dick tied for 21st with an 85.
Pierz Red was led by Preston Athman, who tied for ninth with an 80. Blake Virnig tied for 21st with an 85, Elijah Loidolt tied for 25th with an 88 and Kaven Andres tied for 29th with a 91. Alexander Gruber added a 96, and Tyler Thesing shot a 97.
Pierz White was led by Bradly Tanner, who placed 38th with a 98. Logan Janson shot a 103, Leo Medek had a 107, Gabriel Johnson finished with a 112, Timmy Steiner shot a 115 and Logan Solinger added a 125.
